SELECT (SELECT count(*)=8 AND COALESCE(bool_and(NOT (has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES'))),false) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='r' AND n.nspname||'.'||c.relname IN ('assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_owners','gateway.sdk_model_calls','knowledge.pipeline_work','gateway.authorization_decisions','gateway.authorization_resource_decisions','gateway.gateway_a2a_contexts','gateway.gateway_a2a_tasks','gateway.gateway_a2a_outbound_effects')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname||'.'||p.proname IN ('assistant.claim_runtime_thread_owner','assistant.assert_runtime_thread_owner_for_run','assistant.heartbeat_runtime_thread_owner','gateway.reserve_sdk_model_call','gateway.settle_sdk_model_call','assistant.notify_sdk_execution_revocation') AND has_function_privilege(current_user,p.oid,'EXECUTE'))
